trickyParts: GitHub lists a pull request's checks once per check name and event: a single concurrency group across events lets a review run cancel a pull_request run, leaving that event's latest pr-title cancelled and the commit rollup FAILURE (scratch #2250). The group is therefore pr-title-<event>-<number>.
An inline comment posted alone also fires pull_request_review submitted, so it still starts exactly one PR Title run; the header never says an inline comment starts no run.

A check run carries no event and every workflow run has its own check suite, so newest-per-name alone shows green where GitHub blocks; the pill joins check_suite.id to actions/runs check_suite_id and keys by name, workflow and event (external App checks by name and App).
deviations: The architect's first concurrency addition asked for group pr-title-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}; the head uses pr-title-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} for the per-event check listing above (reported to the architect with evidence, and now plan amendment 2 in the generation 4 plan handoff 23e66cc4). At most one running and one pending run per event, so at most four per pull request.
ce-simplify-code applied one change: as_event became as_review_event (no argument).
